पेरम भट्ट father of Jagannātha Paṇḍitarāja. Prāṇābha-
raṇa 52.

,
 --from Skandapurāṇa (relates to a place in the Tanjore
district, on the borders of the Coleroon). Burnell 196^a.

पेरु भट्ट लक्ष्मीकान्त guru of Jagannātha Paṇḍitarāja. Rasa-
gaṅgādhara Preface.

पेरियप्पा contemporary of Rāmabhadra, the son of
Yajñarāma:
 Śṛṅgāramañjarīśāharājīya nāṭaka.
